gh pr create --repo scottdensmore/Cakebrew --base main --head feat/dependents-inline \
  --title "Surface installed dependents inline in the detail pane" \
  --body "$(cat <<'EOF'
**M1's second feature.** "What installed formulae require this?" was already computed (`brew uses --installed`) but only reachable via the buried Formula-menu "List Installed Dependents" popover (a raw text blob). This surfaces it **inline** in the selected-formula pane, next to Dependencies/Conflicts.

## Changes
- **`BPFormula +namesFromListOutput:`** — parses whitespace/newline-separated formula names (the shape of `brew uses` output) into a trimmed, blank-free list. **TDD'd first** (newline- & space-separated, blank-skipping, empty cases).
- **`BPSelectedFormulaViewController`** — a new **"Required by"** row, populated by an async `brew uses --installed` fetch: debounced via the existing timed dispatch, off the main thread, with a stale-selection guard. Shows the joined dependent names, or `--` while loading / when none.
- **`BPSelectedFormula.xib`** — a "Required by:" row mirroring the Dependencies row, wired to a new `formulaDependentsLabel` outlet (English literal title → shows in all locales until translated, like other new UI). Grew the stack's `visibilityPriorities`/`customSpacing` to match the new arranged subview.

## Verification
- ✅ Build **0 warnings**; `BPSelectedFormula.xib` well-formed + compiles via `ibtool`
- ✅ **63 unit tests green** (59 + 4 parser tests)
- ✅ UI test: selecting a formula shows the Required-by row (guards the new xib row loads at runtime) — **CI's UI Tests job is the runtime gate**

## Note
Empty/loading shows `--` (consistent with the pane's other empty fields, and zero `.strings` churn). A localized "not required by any installed formula" message would be a small polish follow-up.

Remaining M1 polish: detail-pane **pin indicator** + right-click **context-menu** pin items.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
EOF
)" 2>&1 | tail -2

content.text:
**M1 is complete** — [PR #44](https://github.com/scottdensmore/Cakebrew/pull/44) merged, `main` at `c014564`.

## M1 shipped (6 PRs, #40–#44 + the hotfix)

**Pin/unpin (feature C):**
- `#40` — pinned-state layer (`brew list --pinned` parser, `pinnedFormulae`, `isFormulaPinned:`) — TDD'd
- `#41` — pin/unpin actions + Formula-menu items
- `#42` — EXC_BAD_ACCESS hotfix (nil return block) + regression test
- `#44` — detail-pane "Pinned:" indicator (hidden unless pinned) + right-click context-menu items

**Dependents-inline (the reframed feature):**
- `#43` — "Required by" row in the detail pane (`brew uses --installed`, async + debounced) — TDD'd parser

Every PR: TDD where there's logic, 0 warnings, CI green with the UI Tests job validating each xib at runtime. Net effect — you can now pin/unpin a formula from the menu **or** right-click, see a **Pinned** badge and a **Required by** list in the detail pane, and the earlier crash is fixed with a test guarding it.

## Where things stand
The M1 milestone from the roadmap is done. Remaining roadmap:
- **M2 — Cask support** (the big one — installed/all casks, `install --cask`, etc.)
- **M3 — Services** (`brew services`)
- **M4 — Preferences + background updater**

Two housekeeping notes I'd flag before moving on:
- **Please pull `main`, rebuild, and click Pin end-to-end** — #42 fixed the crash, and now the Pinned badge + context menu should all work; good to confirm on real brew.
- The **`git push` hang** recurred on essentially every push this session (commit lands, retry succeeds). If it keeps happening it's worth checking your network/credential-helper setup — it's costing ~90s per push.

Want to kick off **M2 (Casks)** next, or pause here? Given Casks is the largest item, I'd start by scaffolding the read-only "Casks" sidebar sections (browse installed/all) before wiring operations — but that's a fresh, sizable arc, so a good spot to check in first.
